annotations.title: Daily stock screen: gainers, losers, most active

description: Daily stock screen in one call: gainers, losers, most-active, small-cap-gainers, undervalued-growth, growth-technology, undervalued-large-caps, most-shorted or aggressive-small-caps; up to 25 rows with price, day change, volume vs 3-month average, market cap, P/E, EPS, dividend, 52-week position, distance from 50/200-day averages, analyst rating and next earnings. Use to find stocks matching a screen. Delayed data; not investment advice. Example: screen=day-gainers. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

screen.description: One of: day-gainers, day-losers, most-active, small-cap-gainers, undervalued-growth, growth-technology, undervalued-large-caps, most-shorted, aggressive-small-caps (default day-gainers)
